_: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 148 section 3: the Discord invite is written down in exactly one place, so replacing
it later is a single edit and no published link ever breaks.
Entry 151 supersedes the redirect. grouplab.org/discord is a real page now, in the site's own layout, and the only
thing on it that leaves the site is one clearly marked link. The invite appears as visible text there as well as
being that link's target, because some people want to see where a link goes before they follow it. Nowhere else on
the site or in any document carries the discord.gg address, and a test holds that to the one exception.
discordGroups is the channel list in plain words, so somebody can see what they are joining before they join. The
group names are the server's own. The channels inside each group are not written here yet, because nobody has read
them out of the server; docs/notes/for-alan.md request 4 asks for them, and this file is where they go.
